answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the ember solution is checked at the vault gate and logged, the inlet audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 18 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The deposit is 87 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
